newsitem.title: USA: MTS Systems gets $7.3 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: MTS Systems gets $7.3 mln contract.

text.p: MTS Systems Corp said it was awarded a $7.3 million contract from the University of California, San Diego.
Under the contract, it will develop and manufacture system components and perform system engineering for a large-scale Seismic Response Modification Devices Test System.
The new testing facility will be located in La Jolla, Calif., and will perform special purpose testing for the State of California Department of Transportation.
MTS Systems manufactures computer-based testing and simulation systems.
